dial.summary: BTC.D holding near 59% and TOTAL market cap at ~$2.9T confirm BTC accumulation dynamics, with funding rates hovering near zero (0.004%) and stablecoin dominance trending lower at 10.1%; twin macro headwinds — DXY at an 18-month high of ~102.58 and real yields at 2.87% — keep the bid contained as markets await tomorrow's September CPI print (Oct 14), where a sub-3.0% YoY surprise is the binary catalyst needed to reprice DXY below 100 and unlock the next BTC leg higher.

indicators.name: Global Liquidity (Global M2)
indicators.note: G4 M2 aggregate (Fed/ECB/BOJ/PBOC) confirmed at $103,649B per MacroMicro Aug 2026 data (6–8 week lag); no September G4 aggregate yet; US M2 at $23.34T for August (FRED H.6, next release Oct 27 for September data); 4-week trend flat — confirmed rising trend required for supportive status; next full G4 update expected mid-November 2026.

indicators.name: ISM Manufacturing PMI
indicators.note: September 2026 ISM Manufacturing PMI = 54.5% (released Oct 1, 2026; August 54.6%, 4-week change −0.1pp within flat threshold); New Orders 55.3%, Prices Paid 77.9% (highest since mid-2021); status neutral — above 50 but not rising on 4-week basis; October data not yet available; next release November 2, 2026.

indicators.name: DXY (US Dollar Index)
indicators.note: ICE DXY spot at ~102.58 intraday Oct 13, 2026 — an 18-month high per Mitrade; up from 102.21 on Oct 12 and ~99.9 on Sep 9 (4-week change +~2.7%, firmly up); status headwind (above 100 threshold); DXY softened briefly Oct 12 on Russia-Ukraine ceasefire hopes before recovering; October 14 CPI print is the binary catalyst — a miss below 3.0% YoY required for DXY break below 100.

indicators.name: Real Yields (US10Y - CPI)
indicators.note: 10-year TIPS real yield at 2.87% as of October 8, 2026 (FRED DFII10; WatchGold confirms 2.87% for Oct 8; FRED Oct 13 release scheduled); 4-week trend up from ~2.52% on Sep 9 (+~35bps); status headwind (rising on 4-week basis and well above 2% threshold); 10-year nominal yield at 5.24% (Oct 9 close) with strong bond demand noted Oct 12; October 14 CPI is the key repricing catalyst.

indicators.name: 2s10s Yield Curve
indicators.note: October 9, 2026 close: 10Y at 5.24%, 2Y at 4.80% → spread = +44bps (consistent across FRED T10Y2Y, Investing.com, and Nuveen weekly commentary); 4-week trend up (steepening from ~+42bps on Sep 9 to +44bps = +2bps); status supportive (positive and steepening); 10Y yield volatile this week (reached ~5.36% intraday before demand absorbed supply); FOMC Oct 27–28 is the next major curve catalyst.

indicators.name: Fed Balance Sheet
indicators.note: WALCL at $6,747,560M ($6.748T) for week ending October 7, 2026 (H.4.1 released Oct 8; Trading Economics confirms Oct 8 value vs $6,743,031M prior week = +$4.5B); 4-week trend flat: Sep 9 ~$6,737B → Oct 7 $6,748B = +$11B (+0.16%); status supportive (flat at post-2022 QT-pause stabilization plateau); next H.4.1 release October 15 covering week ending Oct 14.

indicators.name: BTC Funding Rates (perps avg)
indicators.note: BTC weighted 8h perp funding rate moved from -0.0015% to +0.0043% on Oct 12–13, 2026 as whale demand returned ahead of Oct 14 CPI (CoinGape); annualized rate ~5.6% (TokenPost Oct 13); 30-day trend down from MacroMicro Sep 30 reading of 0.0067%; status supportive (well below 0.04% overheating threshold — near-zero funding confirms spot-driven accumulation, not leveraged speculation); BTC near $83,600–84,000.

indicators.name: Stablecoin Dominance
indicators.note: Stablecoin market cap ~$300B+ vs total crypto ~$2.92T (Oct 2026 estimates: BTC dominance 59.3% per tv-hub.org Oct 4; stablecoin share ~10.3–10.7% per $300B/$2.92T calculation); Oct 12 reading of 10.1% preserved as most recent confirmed figure; 30-day trend down from ~10.5% (Sep 12) → 10.1% (Oct 12); BTC.D firm at ~59%; status supportive (falling stablecoin dominance alongside rising total market cap confirms active capital rotation into crypto).

upcoming.title: CPI (September 2026)
upcoming.note: BLS Consumer Price Index for September 2026 at 8:30 AM ET — consensus: headline ~3.6% YoY (vs August 3.4%), core CPI ~2.4%; ISM Prices Paid at 77.9% is a leading upside signal; DXY at 18-month high of 102.58 and real yields at 2.87% create a binary setup — a miss below 3.0% YoY could reprice DXY below 100 and catalyze BTC above $85K, while an in-line or hot print reinforces October 27–28 FOMC hike odds and sustains both headwinds.

upcoming.title: Fed Beige Book (October 2026)
upcoming.note: Federal Reserve Beige Book released at 2:00 PM ET — qualitative survey of economic conditions across the 12 Fed districts, two weeks before the October 27–28 FOMC meeting; with ISM Manufacturing at 54.5% and Prices Paid elevated at 77.9%, Beige Book language reinforcing broad-based price pressures or tight labor markets would keep October hike odds elevated alongside the CPI print earlier in the day.

upcoming.title: PPI (September 2026)
upcoming.note: BLS Producer Price Index for September 2026 at 8:30 AM ET — pipeline inflation released the day after CPI; consensus: +0.5% MoM (vs +0.4% prior); ISM Prices Paid at 77.9% is a leading upside signal; a hot PPI following a hot CPI would reinforce October hike expectations and sustain DXY above 102.

upcoming.title: Retail Sales (September 2026)
upcoming.note: Census Bureau Retail Sales for September 2026 at 8:30 AM ET — following the September NFP (+29K), a weak retail sales print would confirm broad consumer softening and reinforce Fed hold narrative; a strong print alongside weak labor extends the late-cycle bifurcation signal; provides pre-FOMC context on Q3 consumer demand ahead of the October 29 GDP advance estimate.

upcoming.title: Initial Jobless Claims (week ended October 11, 2026)
upcoming.note: DOL weekly initial jobless claims at 8:30 AM ET for the week ended October 11, 2026 — released alongside September PPI and Retail Sales; claims trajectory directly informs market odds for a Fed pause vs. hike at the October 27–28 meeting; a print above 200K would reinforce labor market softening following the September NFP of +29K.

upcoming.title: Fed Balance Sheet H.4.1 (week ended October 14, 2026)
upcoming.note: Federal Reserve H.4.1 weekly balance sheet release at 4:30 PM ET — covers week ending October 14, 2026; prior reading $6,747,560M ($6.748T, week ending Oct 7); four consecutive weeks of flat-to-marginal expansion; a shift toward contraction combined with rising overnight rates would flip status from supportive to headwind.

upcoming.title: Industrial Production & Capacity Utilization (September 2026)
upcoming.note: Federal Reserve Board releases September 2026 Industrial Production and Capacity Utilization at 9:15 AM ET; completes the Q3 output picture ahead of the GDP advance estimate (October 29); September ISM Manufacturing at 54.5% and Production Index at 56.7% suggest solid output growth; a miss would reinforce stagflation risk narrative (hot prices, softening activity) into the October 27–28 FOMC.

upcoming.title: Housing Starts & Building Permits (September 2026)
upcoming.note: Census Bureau releases September 2026 Housing Starts and Building Permits at 8:30 AM ET; with real yields at 2.87% and mortgage rates elevated, continuation of the monthly decline in starts would underscore the drag from high financing costs on housing activity; provides incremental Q3 residential investment data ahead of the October 29 GDP advance estimate.
